digest.component_or_area: runner.py module size and import seams
propositions: runner.py grew to 798 LOC on main, exceeding the 700 LOC target established in story 2682, making the headroom test fail when the split is rebased
The original 2682 split achieved 655 LOC from a 698-LOC baseline; replayed on current main's 798-LOC baseline, it produces 713 LOC, still 87 lines above 700
Moving either monkeypatch seam (_import_pydantic_ai or _pai_check_config) would require ~15 test edits across 9 files, violating 2682's zero-edit criterion

The chosen solution extracts both _import_pydantic_ai and _pai_check_config from runner.py into structured_run.py, achieving 680 LOC in runner.py while preserving all monkeypatch and import reference sites unchanged
Full test suite passed (8143 passed, 0 failed) on the rebased stack with the extraction applied
